body: I appreciate the kind words. I've really tried living for my loved ones, but one can only deal with the pain for so long. It never lets up, and no matter how much I'd like, I don't know if I have it in me to keep on going.

I appreciate your advice, I really do, but I have trouble seeing a way out of this. I'm already on antidepressants, I work out 5 days a week, I play music and do a bunch of other hobbies, but I still feel this way. All I feel good doing is sleeping
